title: Advanced Radiotherapy (ART) in Gynecological Cancer Patients (GYN-ART)
official: Efficacy of Advanced Radiotherapy (ART) in Gynecological Cancer Patients (GYN-ART)
summary: This is an observational mono-institutional study. Patients with gynecologic tumors treated with advanced radiotherapy- Image Guided Radiotherapy (IGRT), Intensity Modulated Radiotherapy (IMRT), Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy (SBRT)- will be included and toxicity and outcomes analyzed.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* gynecologic cancer patients
* \>18 years old
* treated with advanced radiotherapy techniques (IGRT, IMRT, SBRT)

Exclusion Criteria:

* other tumors
* \> 90 years old
